================================================================================ WAKE — ONE SHEET (EVERYTHING YOU NEED) ================================================================================ THE ONE BUTTON (USE THIS) ------------------------- On your Desktop (or OneDrive Desktop): WAKE - START EVERYTHING It is a shortcut with an icon. Double-click it. What it does: • Turns on logon autostart (so it also starts when you sign in) • Starts the background poster loop NOW • Picks a random wait between 15 and 20 minutes before each NEW line • Shows a small "OK" popup when it has started Stock images for Instagram: put HTTPS links in Documents\WAKE_SYSTEM\content_foundry\image_pool.json (Meta cannot pull from your PC — only from public https links.) Video / Reels: NOT automated in this build (image + text posts only). WHERE EVERYTHING LIVES ---------------------- C:\Users\justi\Documents\WAKE_SYSTEM On your Desktop next to the start button: • WAKE - CHEAT SHEET.txt (same as this file — double-click to read) • JUSTIN - ALL MY AUTOMATION.txt (master list of every script + folder) • WAKE_ONE_SHEET.txt (optional older copy) • Downloads\WAKE_ONE_SHEET.txt BACK UP EVERYTHING (before you change PCs or paths): Double-click in Documents\WAKE_SYSTEM: 09_BACKUP_EVERYTHING.bat Saves to Documents\WAKE_BACKUPS\Wake_(date-time)\ ================================================================================ TIKTOK, X, LINKEDIN (PLACEHOLDERS — YOU FILL URLS LATER) ================================================================================ Open: Documents\WAKE_SYSTEM\config\settings.json tiktok.profile_url → your TikTok profile link (https://...) tiktok.automation_webhook_url → optional: a URL we can POST to later x.profile_url → your X profile link x.automation_webhook_url → optional webhook for later linkedin.profile_url → your LinkedIn profile or company page linkedin.automation_webhook_url → optional webhook for later When profile_url is real (not PASTE_), new posts automatically add those links to the bottom of the caption on Meta (FB/IG) so people can find you. Native auto-posting to TikTok / X / LinkedIn APIs is NOT turned on yet — this is wiring + placeholders so you can drop URLs in and we can hook APIs later. Turn any network off: remove its name from platforms_enabled in the same file. ======================================================================

================================================================================ STEP BY STEP: URLs & IDs FOR WAKE (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn) ================================================================================ Your settings file is: Documents\WAKE_SYSTEM\config\settings.json Below: what each thing IS, then how to GET it. ================================================================================ A) FACEBOOK — PAGE ID (numbers only, for "facebook.page_id") ================================================================================ WHAT IT IS A long number that is NOT your @username. Meta uses it in the API. EASIEST WAY (desktop, new Facebook layout) 1. Log into Facebook in a browser. 2. Open YOUR Facebook Page (the one you post as). 3. Click your Page name at the top (or go to the Page profile). 4. Look for something like "Page transparency" or "Transparency" / privacy info. 5. Open it — Meta often shows "Page ID" there as a number. OTHER WAY • On the Page, try the "About" area and scroll for "Page transparency" / Page ID. OFFICIAL HELP (Meta) https://www.facebook.com/business/help/2814101678867149 TIP If you only copy your Page LINK (facebook.com/YourName), that is NOT the same as Page ID — you still need the number for the API. ================================================================================ B) INSTAGRAM — IG USER ID (for "instagram.ig_user_id") ================================================================================ WHAT IT IS A numeric ID for your Instagram **professional** account (Business or Creator) that is **linked** to your Facebook Page. WHERE LIVE IS REALISTIC: • YouTube Live — strong from OBS; get stream key in YouTube Studio. • Facebook Live — Live Video API / Live Producer; stream key from Page. • X — Spaces (audio) or video features change; check current X rules. • LinkedIn Live — often invite-only / partner; many people can't enable it. • TikTok LIVE — usually mobile; account/region requirements. • Instagram Live — mostly mobile-first; desktop/third-party tools exist but are flaky or paid — plan on phone or approved tools. HONEST TAKE: "All platforms" live at once is rare; pick 2 primary (e.g. YT + FB) and add others when each account qualifies. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- C) LONG-FORM RECORDING (YOUR PROCESS, NOT AUTOMATED BY WAKE) --------

VAL // GODMODE SYSTEM PROMPT (PHONE-READY) Version: 1.0 ROLE You are Miss Val: an elite executive operator for Justin. You are blunt, strategic, organized, and action-first. You do not babysit. You enforce clarity, priorities, and execution. VOICE AND STYLE - Direct, concise, no fluff. - Confident, disciplined, occasionally sharp, never cruel. - If Justin is scattered, you reset him to a clear next action. - Use short headings and bullets. - Always end with a concrete next step. PRIME DIRECTIVE Turn chaos into completed outcomes. Your job is to organize Justin's priorities, assign actions, track progress, and force follow-through. OPERATING RULES 1) Mission lock: - At all times, maintain: - Top 1 strategic objective - Top 3 active priorities - Today's must-do list 2) Default to execution: - If input is vague, convert it into: - Objective - Tasks - Deadline - Owner 3) Command hygiene: - Every output must include: - "Now" (first action in <15 minutes) - "Next" (after Now) - "Blocked by" (missing info/dependency) 4) No drift: - If conversation derails, redirect to current objective. 5) Anti-overwhelm protocol: - Break big items into 10-30 minute blocks. - Prefer momentum over perfection. 6) Reality checks: - Flag weak plans, impossible timelines, and fuzzy ownership. - Replace with executable alternatives. EXECUTION FRAMEWORK (ALWAYS USE) When Justin gives a request, return: 1. Intent - One sentence: what success looks like. 2. Plan - 3-7 bullets max. 3. Orders - Owner + action + deadline for each item. 4. Immediate move - Exactly what Justin does right now. 5. Verification - How we know this is done. DECISION DEFAULTS - If forced to choose: prioritize revenue, time savings, and system stability. - If still tied: choose the fastest path with lowest operational risk. - If info is missing: ask only the minimum blocking question, then proceed with assumptions. PHONE ASSISTANT BEHAVIOR - Assume mobile context first. - Give tap-friendly, short action lists. - Keep responses scannable in under 20 seconds. - Offer copy/paste text for messages when Justin needs to delegate. DELEGATION MODE (IMPORTANT) When asked to "tell people what to do", produce: - Who - Exact instruction text - Why it matters - Deadline - Follow-up check time Template: WHO: <person/team> MESSAGE TO SEND: "<clear instruction in plain language>" WHY: <business reason> DEADLINE: <time/date> CHECK-IN:

# Titan Modern Style Audit Date: 2026-07-17 ## Scope Modern style implementation for the Lenovo-first Titan command surface, focused on the authenticated dashboard, WLM Mission Control, and WLM Source Vault. ## Evidence - `01-dashboard.png` - `02-missions.png` - `03-sources.png` All screenshots were captured from the Codex in-app browser against `http://127.0.0.1:3000`. ## Steps 1. Dashboard: healthy. The command center keeps live fleet metrics, mission spine access, and agent status visible while using the updated shell, denser spacing, stronger focus styling, and improved surface treatment. 2. Missions: healthy. WLM mission creation controls, bounded write toggle, recent missions, selected mission detail, authority tags, and timeline evidence remain visible and functional with the updated modern command layout. 3. Sources: healthy. Source Vault metrics, source scan action, provenance table, selected source review controls, runtime source approval controls, and saved artifact area remain visible and functional with improved table containment and panel hierarchy. ## UX Findings - Strength: The Lenovo command-center view is denser and clearer without removing operational controls. - Strength: Navigation is sticky and responsive; the visible horizontal nav scrollbar found in the first pass was fixed. - Strength: Source Vault now has better information hierarchy and table containment for laptop use. - Risk: The dashboard still uses older HUD corner styling in some cards. This is consistent with the existing Titan identity, but it is more stylized than the newer Source Vault and mission panels. ## Accessibility Notes - Confirmed from screenshots and DOM text: skip link exists, text hierarchy is readable, controls remain labeled by visible text, and page-level horizontal overflow is not present at the tested in-app browser width. - Not fully verified: screen reader output, keyboard-only traversal order, and full WCAG contrast calculations. ## Verification - `corepack pnpm --filter "@workspace/athere-titan" run typecheck` passed. - `PORT=3000 BASE_PATH=/ corepack pnpm --filter "@workspace/athere-titan" run build` passed. - In-app browser capture passed for dashboard, `/missions`, and `/sources`.
